readerCopy.body: A new opportunity can touch an old point of doubt at the same time it offers a way forward. When Chiron conjoins the North Node, forward movement can resemble an earlier experience of rejection, embarrassment, or feeling unprepared closely enough to bring the old sensitivity into the present choice. The history can provide useful information without becoming the final authority. Progress does not require the old reaction to disappear before a different decision becomes possible.
